s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we are having a fruit picnic!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! Let's find some fruit!

s02_01.text: Oh no! My basket is empty.

s03_02.text: An apple is red and round.

s05_02.text: A banana is yellow and long.

s07_02.text: An orange is orange and round.

s09_02.text: A strawberry is red and small.

s12_01.text: Beep beep! I have a watermelon!

s12_02.text: A watermelon is big and green!

s18_01.text: Hello, friends! What a yummy picnic!

s18_02.text: Lumi, play the fruit game with us!

s22_01.text: A red apple. A yellow banana. An orange orange.

s23_01.text: Thank you for our fruit picnic!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!
